items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I left the band in Baltimore... became the Omer Hicks band.

ctx.x: No, but they--- but you could, very easily. You know, just ruin the whole thing. And, we made one song that day - it was called, "Because They All Love You" and I took a little jazz course on that ---I tried to get that record; I think I was 30 years trying to find that record--- I finally got it.

Well, now, I think for the sake of speeding along here - I'm going to just - real quickly - you stop me if I--- if you want to throw something in --- but, uh, after a couple of years there with Chubb Steinberg that band broke up and it became Omer Hicks---
